text:
deploy-bot: Deploybot paused release window for release v2026.03.14 (slot #873) due to upstream egress 503 spike detected in eu-west-1 during canary. Auto-hold applied. Reason: 503-rate > 5% for 3m.
ops-bot: Alert: https://ops.metrics/redwood/egress/eu-west-1 — spike started at 1768550280, current error-rate 6.8% :warning:
eva: saw the same in SRE dashboard, canary qps small but error type is 503 upstream egress (not our auth). Can we hold and swap canary back to previous model variant?
raj: quick check: logs show backend egress to vendor-x timing out, 502/503 cluster-level. Not related to new code paths in this release afaict. Rolling back model change won't help if vendor is flaky.
marta: agree with hold. We should pin traffic to last known-good release (v2026.03.13) for the remainder of today and plan a staggered retry tomorrow night. We can do a soft rollback of canary and keep prod pinned.
kevin: proposed new window: reschedule remaining rollout to 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC (low traffic). Who can own ops for that window? @marta or @raj?
amanda: CS heads need heads-up — will post to #customer-notify after we confirm reschedule. Also update release notes to indicate reschedule + incident hold.
eva: next steps from my side: (1) pin release slot to v2026.03.13 -> prevents automated rollforward, (2) rollback canary instances to previous image, (3) set retry window for 02:00 UTC 2026-03-22.
raj: I can run the rollback and pin now. Command: ```/release pin slot 873 -> v2026.03.13``` then ```/release rollback canary slot 873 --to-image=sha256:dbcafe123```
marta: after pin & rollback, let's keep an ops watch for 1h and validate egress error rate back to <1%. If still elevated, escalate to vendor support and keep the hold.
kevin: +1. Also add a canary-only metric to check prefix-KV cache hits (just in case new model path changed prefix behaviour). Quick query: `sum(rate(kv_cache_hits[5m])) by (env)`
amanda: I'll draft the customer note: short, factual, no root cause yet. Target send after we confirm rollback complete.
ops-bot: Deploy action completed: slot 873 pinned to v2026.03.13 by raj at 1768553402. Canary rollback initiated; 3/3 canary hosts replaced.
eva: verifying metrics — egress 503 fell to 0.9% within 8m of rollback. Good sign but still want vendor confirmation.
raj: vendor ticket opened (TICKET-4521). ETA 4h for initial triage. I'll update this thread when they respond.
marta: reschedule checklist for 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC: - confirm vendor OK, - run canary 10% for 30m, - lift pin if stable, - run staged rollout 25/50/100 with 15m gaps, - announce to ops/CS. I'll own runbook.
evi: (note: evi didn't participate earlier, remove)
kevin: small note: adjust releasebot windows so next attempt doesn't auto-resume outside ops hours. Add a hard block until 2026-03-22 01:45 UTC.
amanda: confirmed — drafting internal post and customer note, will send once we have final schedule.
raj: vendor updated: they acknowledged a regional egress degradation, monitoring fix deploying now. Will keep thread updated.
marta: closing action items for now: raj pinned & rolled back; amanda prepping comms; kevin set block; I'm owner for reschedule. Reopen thread if metrics worsen. :white_check_mark:
